pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

comment.comment:
honestly, the latest direction for $TM makes sense to me. figuring out what people actually use—and being willing to cut the rest—is a good sign.

keeping launches at the center gives the project a clearer focus. pumpfun, meteora, and twitter deploys staying means there’s still room to build around that core without spreading development across too many side features.

what i like most is the idea of letting demand shape the next roadmap. it’s easy to keep adding features for announcements. being honest about what’s getting traction feels more useful long term.

execution still has to follow, but this gives me a clearer reason to stay interested. i’d rather see telemoney become really good at something people come back for than keep expanding without a clear purpose.

a more focused product, repeat users, and demand that turns into revenue—that’s the direction i want to see for $TM.
